## [0.6.2]

### Added

- Add RGB lighting for Fancier Block Particles and Fanciest Block Particles,
  including their custom batched particle renderers.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Sumire-Labs/Pulsar/compare/0.6.1...0.6.2

## [0.6.1] - 2026-10-31

### Added

- Add RGB source-color presets for end rods and magma blocks.
- Add Future MC lantern, soul lantern and campfire colors, preserving their
  original light levels and lit/unlit behavior.
- Add source-color presets for Thermal Foundation, Thermal Expansion,
  BuildCraft, Railcraft, Forestry, BiblioCraft, OpenComputers and Galacticraft.
- Add a glowstone-colored preset for Extra Utilities 2's glowing glass variant.
  Other decorative glass variants retain their existing behavior.

### Changed

- Align vanilla and supported mod source hues with SuperNova, including
  glowstone, jack o'lanterns, portals, lanterns and Botania's blaze block.
  Preserve contextual brightness, mod-provided color APIs and user overrides.
- Match SuperNova's dim dye palette rounding for Botania buried petals and
  mushrooms without changing their contextual light levels.
- Soften dim RGB hues while retaining absorbed color channels at zero.
  Genuine skylight and other light sources can still mix with filtered light.

### Fixed

- Prevent Celeritas from borrowing sky or block light through closed stair and slab faces,
  fixing light leaks around carpets and flowers underneath them (#20).
- Prevent non-legacy RGB tinting from adding white components back to light
  filtered through colored glass. Apply the same correction to the generic
  shader lightmap bridge.
- Correct the OkLab forward transform to match its inverse, preventing hue
  shifts in isolated primary colors.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Sumire-Labs/Pulsar/compare/0.6.0...0.6.1

## [0.6.0] - 2026-10-30 - The Dawn of a World in Color

### Added

- Add optional RGB block and sky lighting for terrain, fluids, entities,
  particles, held items and tile entities in Vanilla/Forge and Celeritas.
- Add a one-time SCALAR/RGB selection screen with English and Japanese text.
  Save the choice per instance and request a restart when changing the active mode.
- Add RGB_MAX gameplay brightness and an independent VANILLA lighting policy.
  Compatible SCALAR clients can receive authoritative gameplay light from RGB servers.
- Add additive, squared-weight, linear-weight, OkLab, vivid and MAXIMUM RGB blends.
  MAXIMUM preserves neutral full daylight; LEGACY retains the earlier appearance.
- Add source-color presets for Botania, Twilight Forest, Thaumcraft 6,
  Tinkers' Construct, Biomes O' Plenty, Natura, Natura Legacy, Chisel,
  Applied Energistics 2 and Ars Magica 2: Rekindled.
- Add CBMultipart lighting integration and RGB support for ProjectRed lamps,
  fixtures, buttons and light microblocks, preserving brightness and power state.
- Add configurable source colors and per-channel filters in `pulsar-colors.cfg`
  and `pulsar-filters.cfg`. `/pulsar reload` validates changes, rolls back failures
  and relights loaded chunks automatically.
- Add optional RGB shader lighting, tested with Demonica and Complementary Reimagined.
- Add public static/positional lighting APIs, a Forge registration event,
  API/source artifacts and conversion helpers for SuperNova light values.
- Add opt-in lighting/render tracing and Celeritas rebuild diagnostics.

### Changed

- Default to SCALAR. RGB uses squared-weight blending and RGB_MAX gameplay light
  by default; existing explicit mode choices are preserved.
- Upgrade the config schema to version 3, preserving existing settings and filling
  missing options with current defaults.
- Reduce lighting memory use and allocation through shared immutable data,
  lazy buffers and worker reuse.
- Reduce redundant skylight work during chunk generation and updates.
- Batch contextual light notifications and avoid unnecessary polling of constant
  Multipart light sources.
- Align vanilla source hues and stained-glass/pane filtering with SuperNova's
  lighting palette while retaining contextual brightness and explicit overrides.
- Deprecate the legacy no-op light flush API and clarify lighting readiness queries.
- Require compatible Pulsar clients for RGB_MAX servers. SCALAR servers retain
  ordinary client compatibility.

### Fixed

- Save light-only changes on otherwise untouched chunks, including neighbouring chunks.
- Keep lighting usable when mod callbacks fail, retaining previous/static samples
  without blocking chunk visibility or saving degraded light as a valid cache.
- Prevent stale light caches and missed dynamic-source updates around palette reloads
  and cached chunk loading.
- Correct night-time sky attenuation, mixed-hue brightness and signed lightmap
  coordinate handling in RGB rendering.
- Center manual relights correctly at negative fractional coordinates.
- Avoid the OptiFine G5 startup crash (#26). Full OptiFine rendering/RGB compatibility
  remains unsupported.
- Prevent premature lighting-completion reports and missing chunk updates after
  large edits or during initial chunk loading.
- Fix intermittent login packet encoding errors and RGB disconnection handling.

## What's Changed
* RGB Lighting Mode by @pepelys in https://github.com/Sumire-Labs/Pulsar/pull/23
* feat: add public API by @pepelys in https://github.com/Sumire-Labs/Pulsar/pull/27
* fix: avoid OptiFine startup crash by @pepelys in https://github.com/Sumire-Labs/Pulsar/pull/28


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Sumire-Labs/Pulsar/compare/0.5.3...0.6.0

### Fixed

- Prevent skylight from brightening wall faces partly hidden by adjacent stairs
  or slabs (issue #20).
- Sample the exposed surfaces of slab and stair models, including inset treads
  and risers, in Vanilla, Forge and Celeritas lighting paths (issue #20).
- Exclude hidden edge and diagonal light from smooth-lighting corners, including
  slab halves and stair shapes, in Vanilla, Forge and Celeritas (MC-12558,
  issue #20).
- Prevent light leaks through carpets below stairs (issue #20).
- Fix the chunk-packet redirect conflict with SpongeForge's asynchronous
  lighting by preserving its captured section arrays (issue #24).

### Changed

- Reduce redundant TileEntity light sampling and spread background checks
  across ticks with configurable sample and time budgets. Explicit lighting
  update requests remain prioritized (issue #24).
- Improve parallel lighting concurrency by allowing read-only chunk halos
  to overlap while preserving exclusion around writes.

### **Full Changelog**: 
https://github.com/Sumire-Labs/Pulsar/compare/0.5.2...0.5.3

## [0.5.2]

### Fixed

- Prevent initial chunk packets from waiting indefinitely with Fluidlogged API.
  Skip vanilla's redundant random player lighting repair request, which otherwise
  creates new pending samples before every send attempt. Block/fluid updates and
  the contextual-light gate used by Thaumcraft crystals remain active.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Sumire-Labs/Pulsar/compare/0.5.1...0.5.2
